:LINE: 257
:MINS: 1.0

Passes a domain event to an installed notification handler, such as a package-moderation decision. The [[file:glossary.org::#term/integrant][addon]] decides recipients and delivery. With no handler the event is ignored; delivery failure does not reverse the domain write.

* 4. cloud-forbidden-effects
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: platform/cloud-forbidden-effects
:FILE: src/graphden/executor/compile_runtime.clj
:LINE: 1306
:MINS: 2.9
:END:

Lists [[file:glossary.org::#term/effect][effects]] forbidden for sandboxed graph execution, including environment, I/O, network, process, and raw SQL access. Core's ~record-effect!~ enforces the currently allowed set; the [[file:glossary.org::#term/integrant][addon]] selects that set. ~:raw-sql~ is separate from controlled database operations.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/executor/compile_runtime.clj::(def cloud-forbidden-effects][src/graphden/executor/compile_runtime.clj:1306]]

* 5. check-target!
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: platform/check-target!
:FILE: src/graphden/clients/egress.clj
:LINE: 90
:MINS: 1.4
:END:

Validates outbound destinations to prevent [[file:glossary.org::#term/ssrf][server-side request forgery]] ([[file:glossary.org::#term/ssrf][SSRF]]). Resolution rejects prohibited local, private, and metadata addresses. DNS and socket checks repeat validation at connection time, reducing the risk that an address changes between validation and use.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/clients/egress.clj::(defn check-target!][src/graphden/clients/egress.clj:90]]

* 6. sanitize-hiccup

:FILE: src/graphden/web/hiccup_sanitize.clj

Sanitizes graph-authored [[file:glossary.org::#term/hiccup][Hiccup]] before it enters the editor [[file:glossary.org::#term/hiccup][DOM]]. It allows selected tags and attributes, limits depth and node count, and converts unsupported content to safe text where possible. Unrepresentable output returns nil.

:FILE: src/graphden/util/counters.clj

Increments process-wide event counters. Readers compare two snapshots to obtain changes over an interval without resetting shared counters, so independent monitoring consumers do not invalidate one another's measurements. See [[file:../../../docs/MONITORING.md][monitoring]].

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/util/counters.clj::(defn count!][src/graphden/util/counters.clj:65]]

Relays branch and organisation [[file:glossary.org::#term/invalidation][invalidation]] events to subscribed customer-hosted executors through [[file:glossary.org::#term/sse][server-sent events]] ([[file:glossary.org::#term/sse][SSE]]). The remote executor can refresh its compiled graph after a change without periodically downloading the entire bundle.

* 10. RemoteStorage
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: platform/RemoteStorage
:FILE: src/graphden/storage/remote/core.clj
:LINE: 132
:MINS: 3.6
:END:

Implements read-only ~StorageCRUD~ over graph rows fetched from the hub through HTTP. Writes are rejected. ~refresh!~ replaces the in-memory bundle, and the [[file:glossary.org::#term/sse][SSE]] relay described above triggers refresh after [[file:glossary.org::#term/invalidation][invalidation]] events.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/storage/remote/core.clj::(defrecord RemoteStorage][src/graphden/storage/remote/core.clj:132]]
- see also :: [[file:storage.org::#storage/StorageCRUD][StorageCRUD]]

Assembles a customer-hosted executor using remote read-only graph storage, [[file:glossary.org::#term/sse][SSE]] [[file:glossary.org::#term/invalidation][invalidation]], and a local HTTP server. The same execution core runs the downloaded graph while the hub remains responsible for writes.
